entry_side: ask for LONG, bid for SHORT
exit_side: bid for LONG, ask for SHORT
path_separation: MFE/MAE and level-hit times retain the raw four-hour path. Continuation flags and maximum_continuation stop at the first executable structural stop after Bank1R.
payoff_proxy: Executable ask-to-bid or bid-to-ask path: -1R on pre-bank full loss; after Bank1R, 0.5R bank plus half-size terminal runner R. Spread is already embedded in the executable path and is not deducted twice.
